title: Bulk Import and Export: Move Many Content Items With CSV or Excel | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Content often starts in a spreadsheet: a purchased list of leads, records from an older system, or a price list kept in Excel. Typing hundreds of rows into forms is slow and error-prone. The CrestApps Content Transfer module imports many content items from one CSV or Excel file, checks every row the way a hand-saved item is checked, and exports content items back to a file.

In this video:
• Why bulk import and export exist
• Where to find them under the Content menu
• Choosing which content types can be transferred
• Preparing a file: required columns and templates
• Uploading a file, and publishing or saving drafts
• Following an import, downloading the rejected rows, and the actions on each import
• Exporting with filters, large background exports, and downloading the file
• Permissions, for all content types or for one
• Ways teams use bulk transfer
